metadata.purpose: Use source errors as control signals for one persistent notifier that governs fresh source subscriptions.

conditions: Each successful source next is forwarded; source errors are sent to errorsSubject and not downstream.
A notifier next while waiting subscribes another source generation; repeated errors reuse the same notifier.
A source completion or notifier completion ends successfully. Notifier error ends with that exact error.

scope.parameters: One persistent notifier Observable constructed once at the first source error; no delay selector.
scope.callbacks: Notifier selector is modeled by a successful externally supplied Observable; selector throws and invalid inputs excluded.
scope.time: Retry only when notifier next arrives; no clock belongs to this operator.
scope.reentrancy: Post-setup source notifications; notifier next admitted only while waiting after a source error.
exclusions: Synchronous notifier next during original subscription or errorsSubject.next and the special syncResub recursion.
Notifier next while a retried source is still active, which can cause overlapping subscriptions.
Promises/async iterable notifier conversions, callback throws, teardown throws and reentrant observers.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe source generation 0; create errors Subject and notifier only after first source error.

ownership.sharing: Internal errors Subject is shared with exactly one notifier subscription per result execution.
ownership.reset: New downstream subscription owns a new source generation counter and lazily created notifier.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Publish original errors to an internal Subject. Notifier next controls source resubscription; no error value becomes a downstream next.
cancellationCheckpoints: After source failure and while waiting for notifier decision; before every new source acquisition.

rules.explanation: The notifier selector and errors Subject are created lazily on the first source error.

rules.guard: current source generation sends a value
rules.explanation: Successful source values pass immediately, even if that source errors later and is retried.
rules.nextState: Same current source and notifier state.

rules.guard: matching source error and notifier absent
actions: send original error to errors Subject
rules.explanation: On the first source failure, allocate one Subject, call the notifier selector once, and publish the error to it.
rules.nextState: Waiting for notifier next, complete or error.

rules.guard: matching source error and notifier already open
actions: notify original error on existing Subject
rules.explanation: Subsequent retries reuse the same notifier subscription and Subject, without invoking the selector again.
rules.nextState: Waiting for the next notifier decision.

rules.guard: one notifier next while source is stopped
rules.explanation: The notifier next is a control signal, not an output value; it triggers a new source execution.
rules.nextState: Active with next source generation; notifier remains open.

rules.explanation: Unlike repeatWhen, a retryWhen notifier completion terminates the result immediately, even during an active retried source.
Notifier errors terminate instead of retrying. No original source error is substituted.
Cancellation is silent and prevents all subsequent resubscriptions.
